g.text: CTIS public API: euclinicaltrials.eu/ctis-public-api. Unofficial, undocumented, no auth. Fields as seen in real responses on 2026-10-31.

* = a field TrialWatch relies on. Types: str, int, bool, list, obj; date = 'YYYY-MM-DD', ts = ISO timestamp. -> = where it goes (tables: db.excalidraw); registered = core.trial_record.registered. Other codes are kept as received.
CTIS timestamps carry no time zone (e.g. 2026-08-14T03:37:46.157584519) and the API does not say which one; TrialWatch reads a results submission date as UTC, still to be confirmed.
List trials page by page. Used by source sync (CtisClient.search)
pagination.page int page number, starts at 1
pagination.size int rows per page (500 at most)
* sort.property str we send ctNumber: stable paging
* sort.direction str ASC, then DESC (see below)
At most 10,000 rows per query (seen 2026-11-21): a longer list
is read ascending, then descending down to the trials the
ascending pass read. A trial seen twice in one pass is skipped.
One short summary per trial; dates here are dd/mm/yyyy text, not ISO
pagination.totalPages int pages at this page size
* pagination.nextPage bool false on the last page
data[] list one summary per trial, kept
* ctNumber str EU CT number: the source key
sponsor, sponsorType str sponsor name and type, as text
trialPhase str phase as text, not a code
* lastUpdated str last change: evidence goes stale
Full record (~60 kB). Stored untouched in core.trial_record.payload. Unknown number: 200 with {}
* ctStatus str status as text -> registered
ctPublicStatusCode int the same status as a code
* startDateEU, endDateEU date started, ended in the EU/EEA
trialEvents[] list per country: early end, halts
* summaryResults[] list technical results summary posted
* systemVersion str goes up when the file is replaced
* associatedEntityId int the results submission it is in
title, fileType str file name; usually PDF
authorizedApplication obj the authorised trial itself:
authorizedPartI obj the part shared by all countries:
NCT, WHO UTN, ISRCTN, and other
authorizedPartsII[] list per country: sites, status history
Long paths are shortened: e.g. .trialCategory, .trialDuration and .endPoint sit under
authorizedPartI.trialDetails. Full paths of what we read: src/trialwatch/sources/ctis.py.
Two steps. Used by source transfer (CtisClient.download_document)
* url str presigned S3 link, valid ~5 min
(body) PDF the file itself, e.g. type 103
Fetch step 2 right away: the link expires.
Planned. From public docs, not yet checked against live data
query str e.g. the CT or EudraCT number
resultType str lite | core (core adds abstract)
pageSize int results per page, up to 1000
cursorMark str * for page 1, then nextCursorMark
nextCursorMark str token for the next page
* pmid, pmcid, doi str publication identifiers
* title, journalTitle str what and where
CTIS endpoint (used or next in line)
planned source, not built or verified yet
Places and postal codes (CC BY 4.0). Used by trialwatch geo load
country, postal code, place name, admin names,
latitude, longitude, accuracy (404: none, e.g. GR)
each file's sha256. Fetched once per load, never
per search; credited on every page.
U.S. National Library of Medicine. Used by trialwatch vocab load
(no file yet: a redirect to an error page)
GET /retrieve — what a trial's profile reads
From the list row: ctStatus, trialCountries (France:4)
